title: Collapsed remains of the Saints John Mill (associated with Saints John Mine)
label: Associated Saints John Mill ruins — 2022; NOT the mine adit
sourceTitle: The Saints John Mill at the Colorado Ghost Town of Saints John, in September 2022
sourceNote: Uploader's own photograph of the collapsed Saints John Mill at the namesake ghost town near Montezuma, taken 2022-09-05. This is a documented processing facility associated with the Saints John Mine and Mill Complex, NOT a photograph of the mine entrance or upper mine workings. Caption must always preserve that distinction. Original 4032x2268 JPEG.
identityEvidence: Wikimedia Commons original file description specifically identifies collapsed Saints John Mill remains at Saints John ghost town, near Montezuma, Colorado. Colorado DRMS records document the Saints John Mine and Mill Complex and its mill ruins downstream of the Glacier Mountain mine workings; thus the photo documents the mine's associated processing facility, not the mine adit. Never caption as mine entrance.
